scope: Small-model systems proof of concept; not a production runtime benchmark.
representation: torch state_dict plus JSON manifest; the compact artifact executes the learned 2-block compiler natively and does not reconstruct the original 4-block model.

interpretation.storage_distribution: Supported in this PoC: serialized artifact plus manifest was about 50.36% smaller.
interpretation.cpu_execution: Supported in this PoC: mean batch-128 CPU inference time was about 49.1% of the large model.
interpretation.materialization_latency: Observed lower on the five-process benchmark, but cache/filesystem sensitivity was visible in auxiliary runs, so this remains a secondary result rather than a general claim.
interpretation.host_ram: Not meaningfully demonstrated: process RSS delta was about 96.6% of the large model despite the smaller parameter state.
interpretation.generalization: Not established beyond this one CPU, small model, and seed 4300.
